# Portfolio CV

Place your PDF CV in this folder with this exact filename:

`lemith-nanditha-cv.pdf`

The homepage's Download CV button downloads it as `Lemith-Nanditha-CV.pdf`.
If the file is missing or is not a PDF, visitors see `CV not updated yet.`

Use a real PDF file; changing a Word document's extension to `.pdf` does not convert it.
To update the CV, replace this file, then commit and deploy the updated portfolio.
During local development, the file is available as soon as you save it here.

The CV is a public file, so include only information you want portfolio visitors to download.
